prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Name companion, verify traits, finalize adoption certificate"]
1: ["Preparing Desktop Workspace", "Verifying screen overlay permissions and graphic display settings for desktop pet rendering..."]
2: ["Welcome Your Desktop Pet Companion", "Learn basic desktop controls to interact, minimize, or chat with your new pet anytime.", "Desktop Controls: Click pet to chat, right-click for settings, drag to move"]
3: ["Select Your Adoption Path", "Pick a ready-made companion or build your custom desktop pet.", "Quick Pick vs Custom Creation"]
4: ["Your pet is getting ready! Desktop pets love exploring multi-monitor setups."]
5: ["Signing into your primary account ensures your pets and saved progress remain intact."]
6: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Use bright, clear photos with full view of your pet's face for best custom pet rendering.", "Avoid dark, blurry, or cropped photos for accurate pet generation."]
7: ["Begin Your Virtual Pet Journey", "Includes Free Starter Pet Accessory Pack"]
8: ["Desktop Pet Ready Alert Active"]
9: ["Sign In to Save Your Companion"]
